home.title: International trading company in Casablanca, Morocco
home.lead: ALIOM TRADING is an international trading company: we connect manufacturers, brands, distributors and markets, between Morocco and the rest of the world.
paragraphs: It grew out of long experience in distribution, as an agent for world-renowned brands.
Our constant aim is to put our know-how at our customers’ service, with quality service and answers that meet their needs, both technical and commercial.

services.title: Services
services.h1: International trading: import, export and sourcing
services.lead: We offer a complete service to companies looking for suppliers of finished and semi-finished goods, or for producers directly, anywhere in the world.
services.seoDescription: International trading company in Morocco: import, export, sourcing of suppliers and producers worldwide, business matchmaking, quality control and order follow-up.

items.title: Import
items.text: We find the right foreign manufacturers and producers for Moroccan manufacturers, distributors and resellers, and follow up your orders with them.

items.title: Export
items.text: We supply foreign importers with Moroccan products, by the container or in lots, and help Moroccan producers reach international markets.

items.title: Supplier sourcing
items.text: Finished or semi-finished goods, manufacturer or direct producer: we find the sources that match your specification, anywhere in the world, and compare the offers for you.

items.title: Matchmaking and representation
items.text: We connect manufacturers, brands and distributors, and represent international brands in Morocco: prospecting, order follow-up and market feedback.

items.title: Quality control
items.text: Suppliers selected against the standards of your sector (HACCP, IFS, BRC for food), pre-loading checks and independent inspection on request.

items.title: Order follow-up
items.text: We are not a freight forwarder: we follow up your orders with the importing and exporting manufacturers, from confirmation through to delivery, and keep you informed at every stage.

steps.title: Your need
steps.text: Product, specification, volumes, destination and timing.

steps.title: Our selection
steps.text: We consult our sources and propose the best offer.

steps.title: Inspection
steps.text: Quality, quantity and packing checked before departure.

steps.title: Follow-up
steps.text: We follow up your order with the supplier through to delivery.

services.brandsText: Looking for an agent to grow your sales in Morocco? Introduce your brand and products: we review every proposal.

about.title: About
about.h1: ALIOM TRADING: high standards in our customers’ service
about.lead: An international trading company and brand agent, based at 2-4, rue Abou Dhabi, Oasis, Casablanca.
about.seoDescription: ALIOM TRADING, a company founded in 2021 in Casablanca: international trading, import, export, sourcing, brand distribution and representation.
story: ALIOM TRADING grew out of long experience in distribution, as an agent for world-renowned brands.
As an international trading company, it continues this distribution business and now puts its network at the service of businesses looking for suppliers or new markets, in Morocco and abroad.
about.engagement: Quality is the source of our success: we meet HACCP, IFS and BRC requirements. This quality has been built over decades of expertise and through the full commitment and dedication of our team.

blocks.title: Our strengths
blocks.text: High-quality products at the best value for money, with respect for the environment. Our constant aim is to put our know-how at our customers’ service and give answers that fit their needs, technical and commercial alike.

blocks.title: Always available
blocks.text: We keep direct contact and an ongoing dialogue with our customers, wherever they are.

blocks.title: Product quality
blocks.text: We are always looking for the best products, through a demanding, expert selection of our suppliers and sources. We guarantee our customers product availability and close follow-up of every order.

blocks.title: Technical support
blocks.text: We provide effective technical support that listens and is always available to find solutions.

values.title: Efficiency

values.title: Responsiveness

values.title: Productivity

legal.lead: Information about the publisher of this website and about how we handle the personal data you send us.

sections.p: ALIOM TRADING, single-member SARL with a share capital of MAD 500,000. Registered office: 2-4 rue Abou Dhabi, Oasis, Casablanca, Morocco. Casablanca trade register no. 502559. ICE: 002810898000009. Managing director and publication director: Mrs Habiba Ouliass. Contact: info@aliomtrading.com, +212 6 60 16 11 57.

Only what you type into the contact, quote and product request forms: name, company, e-mail address, phone number, country, the products you selected or are looking for, and your message.
We use this data to answer your request and, if you become a customer, to prepare and follow up offers and orders. Enquiries that do not lead to business are deleted after 24 months.
We do not sell your data. Form messages pass through our e-mail provider; logistics partners only receive what is needed for a delivery.
This website sets no tracking cookies. Your quote selection is stored in your own browser (local storage) and only sent to us when you submit the form.

Under Moroccan Law 09-08 on the protection of individuals with regard to the processing of personal data, you have the right to access, correct and object to the use of your data. Write to info@aliomtrading.com.

sectors.title: Where we work
sectors.lead: Our business is not limited to a single category of goods, and it works both ways: from Morocco to foreign markets, and from foreign suppliers to Morocco. Our established ranges are in the catalogue; for other sectors, we find the right supplier for each request.
sectors.note: Your product fits none of these sectors? Describe it: we review every request and tell you frankly whether we can handle it.
